meta.description: Chinese heat exchanger manufacturers can submit technical articles, product updates, case studies, and market notes for editorial review and possible publication in HeatEx Direct Industry News.

og.title: Submit Industry News Articles | HeatEx Direct
og.description: Submit manufacturer articles, technical notes, case studies, and product updates for editorial review and possible publication in HeatEx Direct Industry News.

hero.title: Submit Industry News Articles
hero.description: <0>HeatEx</0> <1>Direct</1> accepts technical articles, product updates, project stories, factory news, and application cases from Chinese heat exchanger manufacturers for editorial review and possible publication.

overview.label: Published In
overview.value: Approved submissions are published in Industry News after editorial review.

overview.label: Reader Focus
overview.value: Content is written for buyers, engineers, distributors, and procurement teams researching heat exchanger suppliers.

overview.label: Editorial Rule
overview.value: We prefer clear, relevant, and checkable material that helps buyers understand products, applications, or manufacturer capability.

seo.title: Show Your Expertise
seo.description: Industry News helps more buyers see your technical knowledge, product experience, application cases, and international communication capability.

audience.title: Who Will Read It
audience.description: Your articles are written for buyers, engineers, procurement teams, distributors, and project owners looking for practical heat exchanger information before contacting suppliers.

screening.title: Editorial Review
screening.description: Every submission is reviewed before publication. We may edit titles, structure, wording, translations, images, and links to fit the site.

verified.title: Public Supporting Content
verified.description: A published article can support your manufacturer profile and help explain your products, applications, project experience, or company updates.

guidelines.title: Submission Guidelines
guidelines.description: Send editable article files, clearly named media, and content that is useful for heat exchanger buyers.

requirements.title: Files and Media
items: Send the article body as an editable Word file.
Send images as original JPG, PNG, or WebP files with clear file names. Large media can be shared through a cloud download link.
Include your company name, contact person, website, suggested title, and any related manufacturer or product page.

topics.title: Suitable Topics
items: Technical articles about heat exchanger design, materials, applications, maintenance, testing, or troubleshooting
Factory updates, production capability, new product series, certificates, exhibitions, or major project references
Application case studies, China heat exchanger market notes, and industry trends

formats.title: Unsupported Main Files
formats.description: PDF-only articles, TXT files, Pages files, screenshots, or Google Doc links are <0>not accepted</0> as the main submission. We need editable Word files for review, formatting, and translation.

content.title: Content We Avoid
items: Pure advertising copy, slogans, exaggerated rankings, or unsupported claims such as 'No. 1' or 'best in China'
Generic AI text without real technical detail, factory context, product data, images, or buyer value
Unrelated company news, copied third-party articles, confidential customer data, or content that cannot be checked

steps.title: Prepare Your Article
steps.description: Send the article as an editable .DOCX or .DOC file, with images and company details included.

steps.title: Email the Team
steps.description: Use the subject line: '[Industry News Submission] - Company Name - Article Topic'.

steps.title: Editorial Review
steps.description: We review the article for relevance, clarity, file quality, and buyer value before publication.

cta.title: Send Us Your Article
cta.description: Email your editable article file, supporting images, company name, and contact person. We will review whether it is suitable for Industry News.
